Leadership & Legacy
Mahendra Narayan Choudhury Balika Mahavidyalaya, Nalbari, is a premier institution of higher education for girls in one of the traditionally enlightened and sensitive districts of Assam. It was established on 01-08-1979 solely with the liberal charity of a great philanthropist of our locality, late Mahendra Narayan Choudhury. It has an ideal location in the very heart of the town and is linked by road and rail with the rest of the country. The college has taken all possible steps for promoting higher education specially among the girls’ so as to mould them into responsible citizens of the country and better human beings. The college is duly recognised under 2 (f) and 12 (B) by University Grants Commission in 1996.
